how_to_apply: Read the official IOCL Eastern Region Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification.
Identify the discipline code matching your educational qualification.
For ITI and Data Entry Operator apprentices, visit NAPS.
For Diploma and Graduate Apprentices, visit NATS.
Complete registration or log in using your existing account.
Verify the accuracy of personal information, educational qualifications, category and aggregate percentage.
Search for Indian Oil Corporation Limited (Marketing Division), Eastern Region, using the applicable establishment ID.
Select the apprenticeship opportunity matching your discipline code.
Complete the application through the relevant NAPS/NATS portal.
After applying, open the mandatory IOCL Microsoft Form.
Enter the additional information requested in the form.
Provide three preferred training/document-verification locations as instructed.
Submit the Microsoft Form within the deadline.
Save the submission details and regularly check your registered email for shortlisting and document verification updates.

Important: Both the NAPS/NATS application and Microsoft Form are compulsory. Candidates who do not complete the Microsoft Form may not receive a call letter for document verification or be considered for further processing.
important_instructions: IOCL has advertised 409 apprentice positions in the Eastern Region. The state-wise vacancy rows currently add up to 393; the discrepancy requires official clarification. Online applications start on 13 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The last date is 12 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. The age limit is 18 to 24 years as on 30 November 2026. Reserved-category age relaxation is available as specified. Regular full-time educational qualifications are mandatory. Part-time, correspondence and distance-learning qualifications are not accepted. The prescribed qualification must have been acquired within the eligible passing-year period. Higher professional qualification restrictions apply. Only one discipline code may be selected. Applications for more than one discipline code will be rejected. ITI and Data Entry Operator apprentices must use NAPS. Graduate and Technician Apprentices must use NATS. Completion of the Microsoft Form is mandatory. There is no written examination or interview. Merit will be based on qualifying examination marks. Document verification and medical fitness are compulsory. The apprenticeship training duration is 12 months. The stipend is governed by applicable apprenticeship rules. Apprenticeship completion does not guarantee regular employment at IOCL. Candidates should regularly check the official website for updates and corrigenda.

content_sections.heading: IOCL Eastern Region Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - 409 Posts
content_sections.text: IOCL has advertised 409 apprenticeship opportunities in its Eastern Region. The recruitment includes Technician Apprentices in engineering disciplines, ITI Trade Apprentices, Graduate Apprentices and Data Entry Operator Apprentices. Important: Candidates are permitted to apply for only one discipline code . Applying for more than one discipline code will result in summary rejection of their applications.

content_sections.heading: IOCL Eastern Region Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications vary according to the selected discipline. Candidates must possess the prescribed qualification from a recognized university, institute or board through a regular full-time course . Technician Apprentice applicants must have at least 50% aggregate marks for General, EWS and OBC-NCL categories , or 45% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates applying for reserved positions . Engineering diploma holders admitted through a recognized lateral-entry scheme may also be considered if they meet the prescribed aggregate-mark requirements. The ITI certificate must be recognized by NCVT or SCVT in the relevant trade. For Discipline Code 112 - Graduate Apprentice , candidates must possess a recognized regular full-time Bachelor's degree in an eligible discipline, including BA, B.Com, B.Sc. or BBA. The minimum aggregate marks are 50% for General/EWS/OBC-NCL and 45% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates applying for reserved seats. Important: Candidates holding higher professional qualifications such as B.E./B.Tech., MBA, MCA, CA, ICWA, LLB or equivalent qualifications, or pursuing such qualifications and completing them before joining, are not eligible under the notification's higher-qualification restriction. The minimum marks are 50% for General/EWS/OBC-NCL and 45% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates applying for reserved seats. Candidates who acquired the prescribed qualification outside the applicable date range are not eligible under this recruitment. No. The notification requires regular full-time qualifications. Candidates who acquired the prescribed qualification through part-time, correspondence or distance-learning mode are not eligible. The notification permits a maximum of two apprenticeship training engagements, subject to the applicable rules. The second apprenticeship must not be in the same trade.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IOCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 12 December 2026. Applications opened on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IOCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 409 vacancies: 206 Technician Apprentice (Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Civil, Electrical & Electronics, Electronics) - Codes 101-106, 97 Trade Apprentice (Fitter, Electrician, Electronics Mechanic, Instrument Mechanic, Machinist) - Codes 107-111, 70 Graduate Apprentice, 16 Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator (Freshers), 4 Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IOCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 12 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 24 years (as on 30 November 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years (up to 29 years), OBC-NCL 3 years (up to 27 years), PwBD up to 10 years (up to 15 years for SC/ST, up to 13 years for OBC-NCL).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: As prescribed under Apprentices Act for Technician Apprentice (Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Civil, Electrical & Electronics, Electronics) - Codes 101-106, As prescribed under Apprentices Act for Trade Apprentice (Fitter, Electrician, Electronics Mechanic, Instrument Mechanic, Machinist) - Codes 107-111, As prescribed under Apprentices Act for Graduate Apprentice, As prescribed under Apprentices Act for Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator (Freshers), As prescribed under Apprentices Act for Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Matric with 2-year ITI (Trade); 3-year Diploma in Engineering with 50% (Technician); regular full-time graduate with 50% (Graduate); Class 12th with 50% (Data Entry Operator). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate must have a PAN Card, an Aadhaar Card and a bank account linked with Aadhaar with a cheque book bearing the name. Active e-mail ID and mobile number valid for at least 1 year are required. Qualification must be a full-time regular course; Part-time, Correspondence or Distance Learning is not eligible. Technician and Graduate: qualification acquired between 01.04.2023 and 30.11.2026. Trade (ITI/Data Entry Operator): between 01.04.2022 and 30.11.2026.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates with higher professional qualifications such as B.E./B.Tech., MBA, MCA, CA, ICWA, LLB or equivalent, or pursuing higher qualification completed on or before joining. PwBD candidates for Discipline Codes 101 to 111. Candidates applying for more than one discipline code. Candidates whose previous apprenticeship was terminated for failure to carry out the terms of contract.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Registration on NAPS/NATS portal and application against the notification. Merit list based on percentage of marks in the essential prescribed qualification. Document verification of shortlisted candidates. Pre-engagement medical fitness test.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Period of apprenticeship training: 12 months. No obligation on the Corporation to offer employment after training. Engagement subject to medical fitness and Corporation rules.
